subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should stranded `message_tool_only` finals recover only behind the new `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` opt-in flag, recover by default through the competing branch, or remain diagnostics-only?
rationale: The path is user-visible and privacy-sensitive, current docs define no message-tool call as private/no source reply, and this PR adds a new config surface rather than just repairing an implementation mistake.

options.title: Keep opt-in recovery after proof
options.body: Approve this default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof demonstrates one bounded retry and no leaked private metadata.

options.title: Prefer default recovery
options.body: Use the competing default-recovery approach if maintainers want existing `message_tool_only` users to get recovery or a diagnostic without adding a new setting.

options.title: Stay diagnostics-only
options.body: Reject runtime recovery and keep the current warning/docs behavior if privacy-contract stability matters more than automatic recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep opt-in recovery after proof
recommendation.body: Approve this default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof demonstrates one bounded retry and no leaked private metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the diagnostics-only policy PR and is the strongest history signal for the product/privacy choice.
